members.name: Maya Lin
members.title: President
members.bio: Specializes in quantitative macroeconomics and monetary policy research. Previously interned at the Federal Reserve Board and Goldman Sachs.

members.name: Julian Vance
members.title: Vice President of Operations
members.bio: Focuses on financial market dynamics and game theory. Incoming Investment Banking Analyst at Morgan Stanley.

members.name: Sarah Chen
members.title: Director of Case Competitions

members.name: Marcus Thorne
members.title: Director of Academic Affairs
members.bio: Coordinates peer tutoring, econometrics workshops, and faculty speaker panels. Passionate about labor market economics.

members.name: Elena Rostova
members.title: Director of Corporate Relations
members.bio: Manages sponsor partnerships with Analysis Group, Cornerstone Research, and BlackRock. Organizing sponsor keynotes.

members.name: David K. O'Connor
members.title: Editor-in-Chief, Economic Review
members.bio: Oversees the peer review and publication of student research articles on macro-policy and behavioral economics.
